adaptation_disclosure.guardrail: These values are validation-label autocorrelation diagnostics, not model prediction metrics.

research_question: Can a shared-QKV dense attention path with head-specific 6/8/12 Angstrom local-pose routing retain global antigen context while using the validation-supported interface scale more reliably than the duplicated dense-plus-spatial encoder?

architecture.global_path: one dense same-chain self-attention stream with sequence RoPE
architecture.geometry_path: additive SE(3)-invariant radial, local-direction, and relative-rotation biases
architecture.routing: independent zero-initialized gate for each radius, geometry component, and attention head
architecture.parameter_sharing: Q/K/V and output projections are shared by global content and local geometry
architecture.initial_function: exactly content-only because all geometry relation gates initialize to zero
architecture.missing_frames: geometry biases are zero for any pair without two valid N/CA/C frames

data.split_method: epitope_group development train and validation roles only
data.second_stage_if_retained: SAbDab2 reciprocal-min Foldseek antigen-fold development train and validation roles only

training_objective.contact: observed-class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.specificity: mean softplus ranking loss over both reciprocal counterfactual directions
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong partners are ranking examples and never receive fabricated all-zero contact labels

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: validation-only parent rule: reciprocal-min interaction-only margin, then contact macro AUPRC within 0.0001, then earlier epoch

pilot_gate.advance_rule: Advance to five seeds only if seed 17 improves validation reciprocal-min interaction-only margin or contact macro AUPRC over matched sequence_dense seed 17, while neither endpoint degrades by more than 0.01.

five_seed_hypotheses.primary: The mean validation reciprocal-min interaction-only margin exceeds sequence_dense.
five_seed_hypotheses.co_primary: The mean validation per-complex contact AUPRC exceeds sequence_dense.
five_seed_hypotheses.secondary: Epitope macro and pooled AUPRC, paratope AUPRC, calibration, spatial-neighbor enrichment, and per-head routing are reported without promotion based on a single favorable secondary metric.

claim_boundary: Adaptive post-analysis development experiment. It cannot alter the frozen confirmatory matrix and does not authorize frozen-test, official-test, external, benchmark, generalization, or state-of-the-art claims.
